answer: Deposits are visible in quill, and sonnet reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 95 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. A farm of 944 identities would post 1404 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
